images.alt: Thirteen identical signposts form a fence across a field. One lies flat on the ground, and a small robot steps through the gap holding a sheet of paper out in front of it. A large check mark floats behind the fence.
images.prompt: A row of thirteen identical wooden signposts planted in a straight line across the middle of the frame, forming a loose fence, all facing the viewer and all carrying the same short rule. One signpost near the centre has been pulled up and laid flat on the ground. A small featureless robot walks through the gap it left, holding a single sheet of paper out ahead of it like a pass. Behind the fence a large check mark hangs in the air. Everything sits in the middle third of the frame with open ground on every side.

images.alt: Two side-by-side drawings. On the left a robot sits inside a frame of struts whose mechanical arms pull a row of levers. On the right the frame is gone and the robot pulls the same levers itself. An arrow points from left to right.
images.prompt: A diagram in two halves, side by side, well inside the frame. On the left, a small featureless robot sits inside a rigid frame of struts and brackets, and mechanical arms belonging to the frame are pulling a row of levers while the robot only watches. On the right, the same row of levers with the frame gone and the robot's own arms on the levers. A single plain arrow runs from the left half to the right half.

images.alt: Four stations arranged in a circle and joined by clockwise arrows: a notepad, a keyboard, a furnace and a set of scales. A robot in the centre turns a crank. A human figure outside the circle holds a dial, and a counter sits above the loop.
images.prompt: A circular loop diagram in the centre of the frame made of four stations joined by curved arrows running clockwise: a notepad, a keyboard, a small furnace, and a set of scales. A small featureless robot stands in the middle of the loop turning a crank. Outside the loop a human figure rests one hand on a large dial that sets the loop's pace. A small counter above the loop shows a number.
